question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.**

You need to be aware of __argus-eyed__ people in the organisation.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Vigilant**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "**argus-eyed**" means extremely watchful or observant. (अत्यंत सतर्क या चौकस)
 
• Marked option **Vigilant **means keenly watchful to detect danger; wary. (खतरे का पता लगाने के लिए पूरी तरह से सतर्क)
 
• In the given sentence, the speaker is cautioning the listener to be aware of such vigilant people in the organization.
 
• The idiom is derived from Greek mythology, where Argus was a giant with 100 eyes who was known for his watchfulness.
 
• The usage of this idiom in the sentence is grammatically correct and conveys the intended meaning effectively.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Angry **means feeling or showing anger or strong resentment. (क्रोध या तीव्र आक्रोश महसूस करना या दिखाना)
 
• **Content **means being pleased with the existing situation and not hoping for change or improvement. (मौजूदा स्थिति से खुश होना और बदलाव या सुधार की उम्मीद न करना)
 
• **Kind **means caring about others; friendly and generous. (परोपकारी; मित्रवत और उदार)
